mapper.insert: insert into my_mall.shopping_cart(user_id, goods_id, goods_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId},#{goodsId},#{goodsCount},#{createTime},#{updateTime})
mapper.select: select sc.id as cartItemId, sc.goods_count as goodsCount, g.cover_img as coverImg, sc.goods_id as goodsId, g.name as goodsName, g.selling_price as sellingPrice from my_mall.shopping_cart as sc left join my_mall.goods as g on sc.goods_id = g.id where sc.user_id = #{userId} order by sc.create_time desc
SELECT oi.goods_id FROM my_mall.order_item oi INNER JOIN my_mall.`order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_status IN (1,2,3,-1) GROUP BY oi.goods_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.count) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
